methods.description: Runs the bounded parser and component comparison twice; compares generated output tree hashes. No global producers run.

conclusions.text: The actual simplified product and retained unsimplified product each have exactly one candidate-intersecting feature, Sechura, which covers the entire candidate component in the bounded geometry predicates. Product choice does not change this candidate-level source-relative relationship.
The current Atlas Sechura geometry touches the candidate only at its boundary and provides zero positive-area coverage; the difference cause is unknown.
Effective source date, authority, licensing applicability, positional accuracy/registration, source-to-current lineage, physical land/water, complete partition and ownership remain unknown.
